name: Immortal Fruits

features.name: xWheel Jackpots
features.description: A wheel that pays until a multiplier repeats.

review:
Immortal Fruits is a 5x4 fruit slot with 50 lines and four-row stacked wilds on reels 2 to 4. Landing all three can cover the middle of the grid.

Three bonus symbols open the xWheel Jackpots bonus, a fortune wheel that keeps paying until the same multiplier comes up twice. There's also a 50/50 gamble. Nolimit rates it High volatility, but the cap is a modest 2,787x and the hit rate low at 11%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
